name: Cicagna (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cicagna (a tower above a bridge on blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI CICAGNA in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Cicagna, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cicagna arms — tower above a bridge on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CICAGNA beneath the arms
